title: Hacia un teatro situado
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This book introduces the concept of ‘situated theatre’ through an analysis of Raúl Ruiz’s dramaturgy; one of the least well-known aspects of his artistic output. His playwriting demonstrates that the text can cease to be a fixed structure and become a living entity, open to the setting and the present moment of each performance, where writing and performativity, fiction and reality, are dynamically intertwined
